scope: Same current Bootstrap/protocol/kit. After retains the exact async stream created and configured by inherited production setup, without fixture replacement or reconfiguration. Before alone replaces the unused idle owner with the preserved original synchronous stream. Every observed callback retains the selected owner. Actual task ownership and joins are recorded in terrain rows. Actual scene boot, supported map travel, first required+Garden readiness then tick-scheduled synthetic action state through the real InputRouter, normal rendering and normal close. Optional explicit synthetic-application-focus forces only the application-input-active Boolean before each inherited callback; real focus notifications still execute all production guard/quarantine behavior and actual window focus is recorded separately. This mode is not normal focus acceptance. Each inherited callback receives declared1/60s;480 successful120Hz ticks. World-tick input waits through pauses; this does not model physical input during stalls, certify focus, FPS, latency, player feel or total CPU speed. Endpoint serialization/readback occurs after traversal only; OS cache and startup costs are not isolated.
